title: 3-line to 8-line decoder/demultiplexer

sources.document: TI SN54LS138/SN54S138/SN74LS138/SN74S138A datasheet SDLS014 (December 1972, revised March 1988)

functions.formula: Y0 = NOT(G1 AND G2A' AND G2B' AND C' AND B' AND A')
functions.text: Y0 is low when G1 is high, G2A and G2B are low and C,B,A = 0; high otherwise.

functions.formula: Y1 = NOT(G1 AND G2A' AND G2B' AND C' AND B' AND A)
functions.text: Y1 is low when G1 is high, G2A and G2B are low and C,B,A = 1; high otherwise.

notes: Timing is the SN74LS138 table (page 4). SN74S138A (page 6, RL 280 ohm, CL 15 pF): select 2 levels tPLH 4.5/7, tPHL 7/10.5; 3 levels tPLH 7.5/12, tPHL 8/12; enable 2 levels tPLH 5/8, tPHL 7/11; 3 levels tPLH 7/11, tPHL 7/11 ns typ/max. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS138 and 74S138.
